QuestInfo.name: Eliminate Monsters from the Site
QuestInfo.0: #p512# asked me to wait while he's analyzing #t4000152# and #t4000153#.
QuestInfo.1: #p512# seemed shocked to find out what he had found out through studying #t4000152# and #t4000153#, but he didn't want to divulge the information on me. He wanted me to first eliminate the monsters, so I'll do that.
QuestInfo.2: #p512# claimed the monsters have decreased dramatically, but I disagree. Not only that, but I felt a strange vibe around the excavation site. What would that be...

0.0: What... this... did this really exist?

yes.0: Please go take care of the monsters that keep interfering with #p516#'s excavation project. We do not have much time, for if the monsters keep interfering and the excavation isn't completed on time, then we may all be in grave danger. Please go eliminate #r100 #o42#s#k and #r100 #o64#s#k. If you can't do it yourself, then bring your party with you and take care of it ASAP.

no.0: If we don't get this excavation complete soon, then we may all be in grave danger. Once you're done preparing to eliminate the monsters, then please come talk to me.

1.0: The numbers of #o42# and #o64# sure have decreased.

yes.0: Thank you for your hard work. This should finally allow #p516# and the excavation team to work without having to watch their backs at all times. But then again, in order to get this done with, they'll need help from someone like you on a daily basis. If you ever walk by the excavation site again, then please help them keep #o42# and #o64# from overtaking the area. Thanks.

mob.0: Please eliminate #r100 #o42#s#k and #r100 #o64#s#k. We can't afford to waste even a second here.
